generic_sampling_rules.int_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1; unique; never NULL. Generated PKs are appended above the compact max; compact PKs are never renumbered or changed.
generic_sampling_rules.int_fk: With probability 0.15 emit NULL when the column is nullable; otherwise copy a parent key drawn uniformly from the FINAL parent key set (compact parent keys + generated parent keys actually written to the instance). Never emit an orphan: every non-NULL value must be in the final parent key set. Assert this in the sampler. Unmatched-join coverage comes only from NULL child FKs and parent rows with no children.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Sample uniformly from the enumerated pool; with probability 0.1 emit a case/whitespace near-variant of a pool value.
generic_sampling_rules.text_free: Sample from a small pool of realistic strings; with probability 0.2 emit a near-duplicate (case change, extra space, accent variant) of an existing value.
generic_sampling_rules.real_rate: Sample uniformly in [0,1] rounded to 2 decimals; with probability 0.1 emit NULL if nullable; with probability 0.15 emit a value equal to another row's value (tie).
generic_sampling_rules.real_measure: Sample uniformly in the observed range rounded to 1 decimal; with probability 0.1 emit NULL if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.date_text: Sample from a small pool of date-range strings in the observed format; with probability 0.1 emit a near-variant (different separator or spacing).
generic_sampling_rules.boundary: For each column with a listed literal, include at least one row at the literal and one row one step on each side (numbers by step 0.01 for rates, 1 for ints; dates by one day).
generic_sampling_rules.tie: For each ORDER column, ensure at least two non-NULL rows share the value at the listed rank.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For each nullable column, at least one NULL row; NULL share equals the compact database's share for that column. Columns with zero compact NULLs receive zero generated NULLs unless listed in null_targets. Columns listed in null_targets get a NULL share of 5-30%. NOT NULL / PK columns never get NULL. A planted NULL is never replaced to satisfy a rule.
generic_sampling_rules.final_verification: Run domain enforcement (rate/measure ranges, sex, dob) BEFORE the final verification pass, or run the verification pass again after enforcement and dedup. Assert every per_column_exceptions target holds on the written rows.

targets.reserve_parent_key: Reserve at least one people.People_ID and exclude it from FK draws so at least one parent row has no children by construction; verify in the final pass.

targets.non_null_share: candidate.People_ID must have a mix of NULL and non-NULL values; non-NULL FKs must match existing people rows (report match rate per instance).

targets.qualifying_rows: >= 2 per real group with different values; exclude NULL and orphan FK rows from grouping

dependencies.note: Draw from final parent key set (compact + generated). Compact people PKs are preserved; generated PKs appended above compact max.

semantic_rules_and_formulas.evidence: observed values M,F; boundary target also plants 'f', legal under case-insensitive predicate

uncertainty: The four rates are sampled independently: no cross-column sum or ordering constraint is asserted (shown rows do not sum to 1: row1 ~1.18, row2 ~1.81). The hard FOREIGN KEY cannot be waived; orphan FK rows are not generated. Unmatched-join coverage comes from NULL child FKs plus at least one reserved parent key with no children (constructed and verified). FK sampling must use the final parent key set actually written (compact PKs preserved, generated PKs appended above compact max); assert every non-NULL FK is in that set and report the non-NULL match rate. The Sex boundary variant 'f' is reconciled with the enum by LOWER(Sex) IN ('m','f'). Domain enforcement must run before the final verification pass (or the pass must re-run after enforcement/dedup) so clamping cannot destroy re-planted group-size, tie, duplicate, boundary or different-value patterns; assert all per_column_exceptions targets on the written rows.
